arguments.message:
I’m sorry you’re having trouble with your two‑factor codes after changing phones. When you reinstall the authenticator app, it generates new codes that no longer match the secret Meridian has on file. To fix this, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**, tap **Reset**, and then set up two‑factor authentication again just like the first time – scan the new QR code and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code. If you still have a saved recovery code from the original enrolment, you can use that to sign in and reset the 2FA from the settings page.

Remember, Meridian support will never ask you to read or type your two‑factor code over the phone or chat. Keep your code private.

If you run into any issues during the reset, let us know and we’ll help you further.
